DDL	CREATE DATABASE showdb
SESSION	USE showdb
DDL	CREATE TABLE show_t1(a String, b Int, c String, d String) USING parquet PARTITIONED BY (c, d)
DDL	ALTER TABLE show_t1 ADD PARTITION (c='Us', d=1)
DDL	CREATE TABLE show_t2(b String, d Int) USING parquet
SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW show_t3(e int) USING parquet
DDL	CREATE GLOBAL TEMP VIEW show_t4 AS SELECT 1 as col1
READ	SHOW TABLES
READ	SHOW TABLES IN showdb
READ	SHOW TABLES 'show_t*'
READ	SHOW TABLES LIKE 'show_t1*|show_t2*'
READ	SHOW TABLES IN showdb 'show_t*'
READ	SHOW TABLES IN showdb LIKE 'show_t*'
READ	SHOW TABLE EXTENDED LIKE 'show_t*'
PARSE_ERROR	SHOW TABLE EXTENDED
READ	SHOW TABLE EXTENDED LIKE 'show_t1' PARTITION(c='Us', d=1)
PARSE_ERROR	SHOW TABLE EXTENDED PARTITION(c='Us', d=1)
READ	SHOW TABLE EXTENDED LIKE 'show_t*' PARTITION(c='Us', d=1)
READ	SHOW TABLE EXTENDED LIKE 'show_t1' PARTITION(c='Us')
READ	SHOW TABLE EXTENDED LIKE 'show_t1' PARTITION(a='Us', d=1)
READ	SHOW TABLE EXTENDED LIKE 'show_t1' PARTITION(c='Ch', d=1)
DDL	DROP TABLE show_t1
DDL	DROP TABLE show_t2
SESSION	DROP VIEW  show_t3
DDL	DROP VIEW  global_temp.show_t4
SESSION	USE default
DDL	DROP DATABASE showdb
